categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches assumeutxo coins cache flush logic in PopulateAndValidateSnapshot with the maintainer label Validation.
categories.rationale: Prevents potential out-of-memory crashes on memory-constrained nodes by bounding coins cache growth during assumeutxo snapshot loading by bytes rather than coin count alone. Commit 9bfcb7c15d notes that flushing only every 120,000 coins allows snapshots with large scripts to inflate cache memory by ~1.2 GB past -dbcache before the file is rejected by UTXO hash mismatch.
